class_id: a value the write path refused keeps its provenance row
feature: any write door that refuses or nulls values AFTER DataConsolidationService has already decided and written their field_sources rows (data-persister upsertIPO: sanitizeIpoWriteFields, the #180 F2 hard-date guard, W-14 merged-record drops)
symptom: Consolidation accepts a value and writes its field_sources row; a later step of the same write path refuses it (nulls or deletes it), so the ipos column stays NULL while provenance names a source for it. The row claims a value that was never set. Downstream readers treat the source as the field's owner: OD-131 records that the stale row made the same source's next valid value read as a "changed own value" (OD-75) and kept it off the page.
first_seen: 2026-09-27 -- ipodhan_staging, read-only: glass-wall-systems-india-ltd (open 2026-09-08, close 2026-09-10, allotment 2026-09-11, listing_date NULL, CLOSED) holds field_sources listingDate source CHITTORGARH created 2026-09-03 05:30:43 UTC, previous_value NULL. Replayed on the real functions: sanitizeIpoWriteFields({open 2026-09-08, close 2026-09-10, allotment 2026-09-11, listing 2026-09-03}) returns listingDate null, while DataConsolidationService Case 1 had already tracked the row. Population, same read: 37 ipos provenance rows naming a NULL column (issueSize 20, listingDate 13 -- CLOSED 5, OPEN 7, UPCOMING 1, matching OD-131 -- priceRangeMin 2, priceRangeMax 2), 2 written in the last 24h.
fix_prs: #70 (OD-131): ConsolidateIPODataInput.deferProvenance holds every field_sources write the call decides; data-persister's consolidation door commits them via DataConsolidationService.commitDeferredProvenance only for fields whose value reaches the row (isProvenanceValueStored), after its sanitizer and guards and after the ipos update. Not fixed: a stored value that the sanitizer nulls on a LATER write of another field keeps its (older) provenance row; the other consolidateIPOData callers write inline (no post-consolidation refusal step measured there). Existing rows: the data contract's repair, not this PR.
detection_check: r_provenance_without_value (docs/reviews/detection-checks/r_provenance_without_value.json) -- any ipos provenance row written in the last 24h whose column is NULL on the row; the standing population is listed in the detail line.
